items: I will check that I am fit for each shift. If fatigue, illness, injury, alcohol, drugs or medication effects could make my work unsafe, I will pause the task and tell my supervisor or a key contact before starting or continuing.
I will leave the equipment, vehicles and shared areas I use clean and ready for the next person. I will follow the cleaning procedure and report any contamination or defect I cannot safely address.

I will present for work in clean, serviceable clothing and footwear suited to the task. I will wear the required personal protective equipment and ask for a suitable replacement if it is missing, damaged or does not fit.

I will promptly report injuries, incidents, near misses and unsafe behaviour, including conduct I witness. I know how to get emergency help and how to raise a concern directly with either key contact.
consent: I have read the handbook, understand the responsibilities above and have had the opportunity to ask questions. By signing, I acknowledge this edition electronically. My signature records this induction and does not waive my employment rights.
